decisions.boundary_condition: Do not infer other amenities, destination, dates, price, views, balcony access, or indoor versus outdoor facility type.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer hotels with a pool, hot tub, and fitness facility.
decisions.condition: When selecting or evaluating hotel options.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize hotels with a pool, hot tub, and fitness or exercise facility, and verify that each is available.
decisions.exception_condition: If no suitable property offers all three, ask whether a missing amenity or a reasonable substitute is acceptable.
decisions.name: prefer_pool_hot_tub_and_fitness_access
decisions.preference_value: Prefers hotels with a pool, hot tub, and fitness or exercise facility.
decisions.rationale: Repeated, well-grounded hotel amenity preference across three conversations; the evidence consistently supports requiring or prioritizing a pool, hot tub, and exercise facility while leaving facility type flexible.

decisions.boundary_condition: Do not let free breakfast override explicit trip constraints such as location, price, room setup, or required amenities.
decisions.canonical_value: Softly prefer hotels with free breakfast.
decisions.default_action: Rank hotels advertising free breakfast above comparable options that do not include it.
decisions.exception_condition: If suitable options do not include free breakfast, present the best matches without treating breakfast as mandatory.
decisions.name: prefers_free_breakfast
decisions.preference_value: Softly prefer hotels that include free breakfast.
decisions.rationale: Free breakfast recurs across three conversations, but wording ranges from tentative to explicit, so retaining it as a soft ranking preference preserves the mixed evidence without overstating it as mandatory.
